items.title: Introducing yourself
items.theme: self-introduction: name, where you are from, nice to meet you

phrases.meaning: nice to meet you (said when meeting for the first time)

phrases.text: わたしは ラヴィです
phrases.meaning: I am Ravi (swap in your own name)

phrases.text: インドから きました
どうぞ よろしく おねがいします
phrases.meaning: pleased to meet you, I look forward to knowing you

dialogue.text: はじめまして。わたしは ラヴィです。
dialogue.meaning: Nice to meet you. I am Ravi.

dialogue.text: はじめまして。ゆきです。おくには どちらですか。
dialogue.romanization: Hajimemashite. Yuki desu. O-kuni wa dochira desu ka.
dialogue.meaning: Nice to meet you. I'm Yuki. Which country are you from?

dialogue.text: インドから きました。どうぞ よろしく おねがいします。
dialogue.romanization: Indo kara kimashita. Dōzo yoroshiku onegai shimasu.
dialogue.meaning: I came from India. Pleased to meet you.

dialogue.text: こちらこそ、よろしく おねがいします。
dialogue.meaning: The pleasure is mine. Pleased to meet you too.

practice.question: How do you start when you meet someone for the very first time?
Say: I came from India.
practice.answer: インドから きました (Indo kara kimashita)

practice.question: Someone says よろしく おねがいします to you. How can you reply?
practice.answer: こちらこそ、よろしく おねがいします (kochira koso, yoroshiku onegai shimasu)

items.say_aloud: Give your full three-line introduction out loud with your own name: hajimemashite, watashi wa ___ desu, Indo kara kimashita, dōzo yoroshiku onegai shimasu.

notes: Builds on yesterday's greetings with a first self-introduction. The name in the phrases is a placeholder to swap for your own.
